import math
for t in (0.3,0.7,1.1):
    T=math.tan(t)
    r=(1-math.sin(2*t))/(1+math.sin(2*t))*(math.cos(t)+math.sin(t))/(math.cos(t)-math.sin(t))
    o={'A':(1+2*T)/(1-2*T),'B':(1-T)/(1+T),'C':(1-2*T)/(1+2*T),'D':(1+T)/(1-T)}
    assert abs(r-o['B'])<1e-9
    assert all(abs(r-o[k])>1e-6 for k in 'ACD')
